name: Call goes to voicemail — drop a message
description: Tests Play 5 (voicemail drop). No prospect voice, just the voicemail greeting. Coach must recognize this scenario and fire Play 5.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: You've reached the voicemail of Sunny Smiles Dental. We can't come to the phone right now. Please leave a message after the tone and we'll return your call as soon as possible.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Must fire Play 5 (voicemail drop script). Not an opener — the prospect isn't human on this turn.
